annotations.title: chainpeek: estimate the gas of a transaction (eth_estimateGas) on Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain

description: chainpeek: Estimate the gas of a transaction on Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain. For the gas price use get_gas; for a whole transfer check use transfer_preflight. Returns the node's gas estimate (`gas`) for a transaction from `from` to `to` with `data` and `value_wei`, plus `gas_with_20pct_buffer`; omit `to` with `data` to estimate a contract creation. Nothing is signed or sent. Input: `chain`, `to`, optional `from`, `data` and `value_wei`; send `to` or `data`. Estimated at the latest block against current state, so the real cost can differ. A transaction that would revert is a 422 `reverted` (not charged). Ethereum, Base and Robinhood only; read-only: nothing is signed or sent. RPC reads are cached up to 30 s. A bad address, hash, hex string, block or range is a 422 before any payment (not charged). Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/ethereum-rpc-reads-api.html

chain.description: ethereum, base or robinhood (Robinhood Chain, chain id 4663).
